test_title: PYST 25: SSC GD Constable 2022 - Reasoning (Held On : 23 Jan 2023 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question:
Select the figure from among the given options that can replace the question mark (?) in the following series.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/bbc5eeb475b1b9013db299c5edba063b038e779a8947ee405606d45827c2400f.png]
solution:
The logic followed in the given figure series:

**From Figure (1) to (2):**

The symbol moves as shown below and S changes into #.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/aa19cced915f17ad713f02c65a9ba76bda07a069d03859d4578c6ca933abd4f2.png] 

**From Figure (2) to (3):**

The symbol moves as shown below and the square changes into the black dot.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b1a0cc049bf0418877fd9f4e018dd58c99dd07221bf65083c2e4103c898051ec.png] 

**From Figure (3) to Answer Figure (4):**

The symbol moves as shown below and # changes into =.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a6334ea1575ae5b745c4d6c0e6d0341a1308d76d8c18c3f6a5bc61fd8468514e.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is "Option (3)".
